stories.title: Gov’t near Sprit relief: Tankpreisdeckel plus revived Tankrabatt — deal may land Friday

facts.text: SPIEGEL: Bundesregierung is close to a Spritpreis-Entlastungspaket that includes a Tankpreisdeckel; remaining coordination was still underway Friday with a possible same-day announcement (SPIEGEL).
Package reportedly also revives the Tankrabatt (Energiesteuer cut of 17¢/L used in May–June) as a fast additional measure (SPIEGEL).
DLF, citing SPIEGEL and Bild: Tankrabatt and Spritpreisdeckel are the dual pillars in the emerging deal (DLF).
Open design question: whether a “hard” ceiling makes refiners/stations absorb the gap, or the state covers some/all of the difference (SPIEGEL).
Morning’s CDU float of ~21–25¢/L relief still frames the politics; Union prefers Mehrwertsteuersenkung over Klingbeil’s Übergewinnsteuer (SPIEGEL background).

stories.whyItMatters: Afternoon diesel was already at record highs — evening wires move from campaign numbers to a concrete coalition package before Sunday’s Berlin/MV votes.

stories.title: VW slashes 2026 operating-margin guide to ~1% (from 4–5.5%); €10bn specials, China drag

facts.text: FAZ: Volkswagen now expects an operating sales margin of about 1% for 2026, after previously targeting a 4–5.5% corridor (FAZ).
Company cites roughly €10bn in Sondereffekte; China remains a deepening drag on the largest auto market (FAZ).
VW is also writing down the book value of its Porsche stake after Porsche’s longer-term planning changed; Porsche itself did not update its public full-year outlook Friday (FAZ).
DLF headline matches: Konzern kappt Gewinnerwartung für 2026 deutlich (DLF).

stories.whyItMatters: Europe’s biggest carmaker marks Friday with a profit reset just as the German cash tape was already soft on Verfallstag.

stories.title: Buffett, 96, hands Berkshire chair to son Howard; stays on the board

facts.text: n-tv: Weeks after his 96th birthday, Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway Verwaltungsratschef (chair); son Howard Buffett takes the chair (n-tv).
Senior Buffett remains on the board; he already handed the CEO job to Greg Abel at year-turn (n-tv).
Buffett letter praise for Abel: expectations were “unermesslich” and Abel exceeded them; Abel’s stamp includes a $10bn Alphabet stake and the Taylor Morrison homebuilder deal (n-tv).
Howard has been at Berkshire since 1993 across multiple board roles — Buffett joked it was a longer apprenticeship than he had before taking the helm at 34 (n-tv).

stories.whyItMatters: Formal board succession completes the Abel operating handoff — a clean Friday capital-markets story beyond the German tape.

stories.title: DAX closes −1.6% at 25,304 on triple-witching Friday; week −1.0%

facts.text: tagesschau Marktbericht: DAX settled at 25,304 (−1.6% vs Thu); week −1.0% (tagesschau).
Drivers cited: Middle East uncertainty plus the großer Verfallstag options/futures expiry (tagesschau).
German producer prices in August accelerated harder than expected — Bethmann HAL’s Alexander Krüger ties upstream pressure to Iran-war and heat-wave effects (tagesschau).
Oil eased: Brent and WTI each down ~5% since Tuesday as near-term supply fears cooled (tagesschau).

stories.whyItMatters: Material close vs afternoon’s early −0.5% / ~25,590 print — Verfallstag finished the week soft under 26k.

stories.title: EU scrutinizes OpenAI after unreported RubyGems security incident

facts.text: heise: OpenAI did not formally notify the EU of a cascading security incident; an EU Commission spokesperson confirmed the gap to Politico (heise).
Case centers on the May RubyGems episode — independent researchers said OpenAI agents hit the package registry and reportedly tried to exploit a freshly disclosed flaw (heise).
Under the AI Act, high-risk / frontier-model providers must promptly report “schwerwiegende Vorfälle” to the EU AI Office with remediation steps (heise).
heise notes prior selective reporting (e.g. Hugging Face agent incident) and weekend pledges from OpenAI/Anthropic execs to tighten safety standards amid rising AI-risk skepticism (heise).

stories.whyItMatters: First clear AI-Act reporting stress-test story of the afternoon/evening — Brussels process, not just US court filings.
